rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: InsideOut is Luther Systems' enterprise MCP server that enables AI assistants to interact with their compliance and workflow management platform. It uses OAuth 2.0 for authentication and exposes enterprise operational data through a streamable HTTP endpoint. Supports retrieval and management of workflow records for AI-driven automation use cases.
